status_definitions.identity_resolved: Exact reviewed identity with canonical keys; never textual similarity.
status_definitions.partial_coverage_candidate: At least one relevant profile field is evidenced; eligibility is reported independently.
status_definitions.profile_scoreable: Every required criterion and one member of each required_any group is calculable.
status_definitions.profile_eligible: Identity, temporal, conflict, human-approval and declared categorical/eliminatory gates pass.
status_definitions.methodology_ready: Profile is scoreable and eligible and reaches minimum weighted evidence coverage.
status_definitions.recommended: Only after methodology readiness, complete TCO and an explicitly executed recommendation ranking.

price.justification: Declared acquisition-preference anchors for a used-car pilot, not market extrema or affordability proof.

urban_fuel.justification: Declared monthly fuel expenditure anchors under an explicit common distance and fuel-price scenario; not complete TCO.

footprint.justification: External envelope length times width including mirrors; smaller envelope preference, not turning radius or parking guarantee.

passenger_space.justification: Rear legroom times measured interior width, an explicit geometric proxy only; not comfort, external width or seat count.

cargo.justification: Declared luggage-capacity preference; rear seats upright; no cargo-to-cabin conversion.

seats.justification: Declared passenger-capacity preference, not space or ride comfort.

payload.justification: Declared total payload preference; includes occupants and baggage, not commercial usable payload.

operating_cost.justification: Requires source-backed fuel and maintenance; excludes generic rates and does not represent complete ownership cost.

highway_consumption.justification: Fixed gasoline efficiency preference anchors, not cohort min/max or real-world fuel guarantee.

mass_power.justification: Gasoline nominal power and compatible curb mass; proxy for power loading, not safety or measured acceleration.

clearance.justification: Declared nominal ground-clearance preference; load and tire caveats preserved, not off-road ability.

interior_proxy.justification: Wheelbase times BODY width without mirrors; explicitly weak external proxy, not measured cabin space.

safety.formula: 100*(min(airbags,6)/6 + ABS + ESC)/3; all three observations required
safety.justification: Transparent equipment inventory preference only; not crash-test performance, reliability or probability of injury.

transmission.formula: 100 if explicit user preference matches, otherwise 0; null when preference or evidence absent
transmission.justification: No universal ordering of manual/automatic/CVT. Default weight zero until preference is explicitly selected.

suv.compatibility_key_note: Historical key only; it does not classify or require SUV body style.

formula: u=100*clamp((x-L)/(U-L),0,1) for higher; u=100*clamp((U-x)/(U-L),0,1) for lower. No sample statistics.
weight_rule: Positive original weights renormalized only over available criteria per vehicle; exact Decimal, final remainder to last criterion. Missing has zero effective weight but null utility and null contribution. Coverage never multiplies score.
readiness_rule: Identity approved; target FIPE month matched; all required criteria and at least one of each required_any; coverage >=0.80; no source conflict; human substitution approval when required. Ready means calculable and eligible in the methodological pilot, not recommendation, publication or efficacy.
recommendation_rule: Recommended requires methodology readiness, complete five-component TCO and an explicitly executed recommendation ranking. Diagnostic preview order is never recommendation.
nominal_scope: Official same-year nominal geometry is accepted only as explicitly qualified pilot geometry. Trim-dependent unresolved ranges remain null. Never a measured individual vehicle claim.

sensitivity.purpose: One-at-a-time checks, not fit to desired rankings or selected cohort

limitations: Weights and utility anchors are declared methodological assumptions, not validated user preferences or evidence of efficacy.
Partial scores using different evidence subsets are exploratory and not interchangeable final suitability scores.
Publication and operational activation remain disabled regardless of methodological readiness.
No generic maintenance, depreciation, insurance, confidence score, brand, collection group or desired rank enters the score.
Statistical confidence is null until calibrated; traceability, availability and weighted coverage are separate.
Fuel-price scenario is not an observed ANP price. No claim of complete TCO or budget eligibility from partial costs.
